training.title: Training
training.body: Read the criterion, practice with your team, then request a supervisor observation. Reading alone does not verify a skill.
training.reviewBody: Observe the demonstration before deciding. You see only positions below you in this venue’s reporting chain.
training.setupBody: Publish clear bilingual criteria. A new version preserves earlier evidence and requires new observations.
training.defaultNote: Starting program. Your company can replace these criteria with its approved procedures.
training.noCourse: Your role governs the training system
training.noCourseBody: Use the operating playbook, review team demonstrations or publish company standards. You do not certify your own work.
training.requestHelp: Describe the work only. Do not include guest or private personal information.
training.requested: Your request is waiting for a supervisor observation.
training.reviewNote: Observed evidence or next practice step
training.reviewHelp: At least 5 characters. Explain what you observed or exactly what to practice next.
training.emptyBody: Requests from your reporting chain appear here. New program versions require new requests.
training.archivedBody: Earlier evidence stays in history and does not verify the current version. The latest 50 records are shown.
training.historyLimit: Latest 20 events per criterion. Earlier observations are preserved.
training.invalid: Complete both languages for each title, criterion and demonstration.
training.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. Keep the key when the same skill is revised.
training.changed: These changes will apply company-wide. Previous versions remain in history.
training.noAutomatic: Verification records learning. It does not enable a position or approve a promotion.
training.defaultEvidence: Demonstrate: {skill}. Follow the current house procedure; the supervisor records what they observed.

chef_de_cuisine.i2: Brief the kitchen on menu changes
chef_de_cuisine.i3: Review a station demonstration with feedback

floor_manager.i2: Resolve a service request through its responsible role
floor_manager.i3: Record attendance and handle a formal proposal
floor_manager.i4: Review evidence and file a complete close

agm.i1: Build a week using positions and availability
agm.i2: Staff events and publish a reviewed schedule
agm.i3: Resolve a swap through colleague and manager steps
agm.i4: Review confirmations and handoff coverage gaps

gm.i1: Explain the venue state and its reasons
gm.i2: Review manager closes and unresolved issues
gm.i3: Propose a documented promotion through the chain
gm.i4: Coach a manager using observed evidence

director.i1: Review venue exceptions across the company
director.i2: Publish a clear company standard in both languages
director.i3: Review a promotion with its evidence and effective date
director.i4: Coordinate corrective priorities through general managers

training.stale: The program or observation changed. Reload the screen and review the current version before trying again.
training.handled: This request has already been handled. Reload the screen to see the recorded decision.

operations.title: Your operating playbook
operations.scope: These steps guide your workflow. Published house rules and the manager’s service briefing define the exact procedure.

polisher.outcome: Keep service stations ready with clean, inspected equipment.
polisher.before: Confirm your shift; inspect glassware and stock your station.
polisher.during: Replace damaged pieces and follow the captain’s station priorities.
polisher.after: Complete closing work and report missing or damaged supplies.

busser.outcome: Keep your section clean and ready for each guest.
busser.before: Read your section assignment and prepare water and reset supplies.
busser.during: Handle water and clearing requests; coordinate resets with the captain.
busser.after: Reset stations, complete side work and report unresolved requests.

runner.outcome: Deliver the correct dish to the correct table and seat.
runner.before: Review the menu, allergens, unavailable items and table numbers.
runner.during: Follow the expo’s handoff; stop and ask when a seat or allergy is unclear.
runner.after: Finish station work and report missing equipment to your lead.

server.outcome: Guide your tables through an informed, coordinated service.
server.before: Confirm changes, review your section and read pre-shift notes.
server.during: Record table and seat allergy notes; coordinate support through requests.
server.after: Complete side work and pass unresolved table issues to the captain.

captain.outcome: Coordinate your section team and verify service standards.
captain.before: Review coverage, assign sections and brief your team.
captain.during: Resolve service requests, observe practice and escalate issues to the manager.
captain.after: Review unfinished work and send factual issues through the supervision chain.

host.outcome: Welcome guests using the room’s current section plan.
host.before: Read the floor plan, section assignments and pre-shift notes.
host.during: Coordinate seating with the maître d’; use the venue’s reservation system separately.
host.after: Hand over unresolved arrival issues and complete reception side work.

maitre_d.outcome: Coordinate reception and the dining room as one service.
maitre_d.before: Review sections and brief hosts and captains on the service plan.
maitre_d.during: Balance room priorities, support captains and review training demonstrations.
maitre_d.after: Report unresolved service issues and team needs to the manager.

expo.outcome: Protect the handoff between the kitchen and dining room.
expo.before: Review allergy notes, seats, menu changes and unavailable items.
expo.during: Confirm allergy notes, verify plate handoffs and publish unavailable items promptly.
expo.after: Hand over unresolved allergy and availability issues to the chef and manager.

barback.outcome: Keep the bar supplied and report shortages early.
barback.before: Prepare ice, glassware and garnish; read bar side work.
barback.during: Report items Low or Out and replenish under the bartender’s direction.
barback.after: Clean and restock; leave open shortages documented for the next service.

bartender.outcome: Deliver consistent drinks and maintain a prepared bar.
bartender.before: Read drinks changes, allergens and current shortages.
bartender.during: Follow house specifications, report shortages and coach the barback’s practice.
bartender.after: Complete bar closing work and flag unresolved shortages to the bar lead.

head_bartender.outcome: Lead bar readiness, standards and coordinated replenishment.
head_bartender.before: Review staffing, shortages and the drinks briefing.
head_bartender.during: Support bartenders, update shortage decisions and propose menu changes.
head_bartender.after: Verify closing duties and hand unresolved bar issues to the manager.

sommelier.outcome: Make wine knowledge usable throughout the service team.
sommelier.before: Review wine availability, pairings and menu changes.
sommelier.during: Support wine service and propose updates through the approved menu workflow.
sommelier.after: Hand over availability concerns and training needs to the maître d’.

dishwasher.outcome: Keep clean equipment and safe, orderly work areas available.
dishwasher.before: Read station duties and check equipment using house instructions.
dishwasher.during: Keep clean and used equipment separated; report defects to the sous chef.
dishwasher.after: Complete cleaning evidence and report anything unsafe or unfinished.

prep_cook.outcome: Prepare an organized station following the kitchen’s instructions.
prep_cook.before: Read station duties, changes and the kitchen briefing.
prep_cook.during: Follow the chef’s preparation instructions; escalate shortages and unclear allergen information.
prep_cook.after: Complete cleaning and labeling duties; hand unresolved items to the sous chef.

line_cook.outcome: Run your station consistently within the kitchen team.
line_cook.before: Review station readiness, menu changes and allergy notes.
line_cook.during: Follow the sous chef and expo; report unavailable items immediately.
line_cook.after: Complete station closing work and report unresolved equipment or preparation issues.

sous_chef.outcome: Coordinate kitchen execution and develop station readiness.
sous_chef.before: Review kitchen coverage, station work and pre-shift changes.
sous_chef.during: Coordinate the line, confirm allergy handling and observe staff practice.
sous_chef.after: Review unfinished work and hand kitchen issues to the chef de cuisine.

chef_de_cuisine.outcome: Own kitchen standards and accurate menu information.
chef_de_cuisine.before: Review coverage, menu changes, allergens and training needs.
chef_de_cuisine.during: Support the sous chef, publish accurate menu content and verify kitchen standards.
chef_de_cuisine.after: Hand kitchen exceptions and next-service priorities to the GM and duty manager.

floor_manager.outcome: Run the service and leave a complete operational handoff.
floor_manager.before: Review coverage and pending confirmations; open the service and assign sections.
floor_manager.during: Support area leads, decide requests and record attendance and formal issues.
floor_manager.after: Review open items, shortages and cleaning before filing the close.

agm.outcome: Translate the venue plan into a staffed, confirmed week.
agm.before: Review availability, time off, event staffing and coverage.
agm.during: Publish reviewed schedules, resolve requests and support the duty manager.
agm.after: Review confirmations and closes; hand unresolved coverage needs to the GM.

gm.outcome: Own venue standards, people decisions and unresolved exceptions.
gm.before: Review the venue state, its reasons, staffing and previous handoff.
gm.during: Support managers, review standards and propose justified personnel decisions.
gm.after: Review closes and unresolved issues; escalate venue needs to operations.

director.outcome: Keep venue execution consistent with company standards.
director.before: Review each venue’s state and identify decisions needing follow-up.
director.during: Work through GMs, review promotions and publish clear company standards.
director.after: Review unresolved venue exceptions and bring company decisions to the owner.

owner.outcome: Govern company standards and hold operational leadership accountable.
owner.before: Review venue states, critical reasons and decisions awaiting authorization.
owner.during: Set company standards and configuration; direct follow-up through operations leadership.
owner.after: Review the decision history and confirm priorities with the director.
